ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels across central lobes and 15% low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the perimeter and notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes; distinct low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; localized dark pixel mottling concentrated at the proximal center surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55-60 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 25% into the vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent micro-serrations and macro-jaggedness; peak-to-valley amplitudes increase in frequency and depth toward the distal ends of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge originating from the median notch and extending to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of three distinct unaligned linear pixel disruptions: two parallel diagonal dark marks on the left lobe and one long, high-contrast diagonal scratch on the distal quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and small missing tissue segments along the trailing edge boundary; dark markings on the right lobe distal tip suggesting historical abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical white pigmentation pattern with rare, isolated linear scarring serves as a unique visual identifier.
